To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) Fashion retailing has a need for a global product master database that integrates product data for all existing sales channels, 2) the master database should be based on a master data model that is designed for fashion retailing and that includes all relevant master data entities, 3) fashion retailing needs a more strict data governance than general consumer retailing.

“The data dimension in fashion retailing is more complex than for general retailing, and requires a more strict and structured master data management approach to be successful in omni-channel retail”.

the fashion retailing industry is changing into a more technology driven business, that the data dimension of the industry is not well developed yet, and that there are opportunities to improve data quality, data management and data governance to increase the business value of data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the data dimension of retailing and the impact of the data dimension on business development.
how the fashion retail industry can improve its data-driven decision making and business development.
how to design and implement a fashion retailing data model that supports business development, and how to manage this data to support business development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the master data model for fashion retailing is more complex than for general retailing, as the product master data is more complex.
fashion retailing needs an advanced master data model and data management that is more strict than general retailing.
fashion retailing is a data driven business and the data model and master-data governance should be designed accordingly to support the business model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
fashion retailing needs to develop a data-driven business model, which includes a master data model, and master data management, and that this is a major challenge for fashion retailers.
fashion retailing needs a more dynamic master data model than general retailing.
fashion retailing needs a more dynamic and more agile master data model than other types of retailing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
master data management is a strategic business process that requires a lot of attention from the top management.

fashion retailers need to develop a master data management strategy that is aligned with their business development strategy, and that the data management strategy should be based on the data characteristics of the industry, and the business processes of the company.
the data dimension is an important and underpinning part of the business model of fashion retailing.
